proposal.observation: Parent NaFadeNet+ExtrapGate(s=50) 3-split MAPE 0.1087 ± 0.0085; split-2024 parent NA-E011 MAPE 0.1091.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: If the fade inputs contributes to the parent's gain, removing it (no explicit capacity-ratio inputs (r_d, r_c removed from the state; extrapolation gate unchanged)) raises 3-split MAPE above the parent 0.1087 ± 0.0085.
proposal.question_inherited: How much of the GateRepair gain is due to the fade inputs? (architecture.md §5 Run C)
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Gate stuck at init; late-prefix MAPE 0.10-0.12 on split 2021 while the extrapolation alone reaches 0.04-0.05 there.
proposal.why_this_experiment: Attribution ablation owed by architecture.md §5 after the Phase-1 target was met; identical config except one component.
proposal.modification: Parent NA-E009 config with use_fade=False: no explicit capacity-ratio inputs (r_d, r_c removed from the state; extrapolation gate unchanged).
proposal.held_constant_components: Parent NA-E009 config except the removed fade inputs; split 2024, seed 2024, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2024 and training seed 2024, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2024 MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15 vs the split-matched parent NA-E011 (MAPE 0.1091, Acc@15 0.743, RMSE 24.3); prefix bands, spread, bias, per-cell.
proposal.rejection_condition: Ablation (diagnostic): the component is credited if the 3-split ablated MAPE is >= 0.008 worse than the parent; no promotion from ablations.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.
